storeWriteMs.margin: Shared-runner allowance; median of five full 10,000-row normalizations.

storeReadMs.margin: Shared-runner allowance; median of five 10,000-fragment traversals.

storeCollectMs.margin: Shared-runner allowance; median of five full unretained collections.

storeHeapBytes.margin: Retained normalized graph after forced GC; excludes the preallocated input.

storeAfterGCBytes.margin: Allows V8 bookkeeping noise while catching retention of the full graph.

burstMs.margin: 100 events over one simulated second; median of five wall-time runs on shared runners.

burstNotifications.margin: Exactly one per changed row, no notification amplification; also asserted equal to 100.

compileMs.margin: About four times the local median for shared CI runners; includes schema construction, validation and artifacts.

mainRawBytes.margin: Minified standalone entry closure, external peers; permits modest runtime growth.

mainGzipBytes.margin: Level-9 gzip of the same standalone closure.

reactRawBytes.margin: Standalone React closure including shared client code; peers external.

reactGzipBytes.margin: Level-9 gzip of the React closure.

windows1HeapBytes.margin: 10,000 rows per real window; permits browser/V8 version variance.

windows1Sockets.margin: Exactly one socket per window; also checked during readiness.

windowMarginalHeapBytes.margin: Maximum marginal JS heap across 1→3 and 3→6 windows; browser variance allowance.

baselineMethod: Median of five complete command runs; each timing within each command is itself a median of five samples. Window heap is a median of five independent browser runs.
